title: DAOGenie
tagline: DAO Genie turns community decisions into real-world actions with simple governance and automated execution, building the bridge between digital communities and physical impact.

prizes.placement: Best Project Deployed on Linea and MetaMask JSON-RPC API

description:
DAO Genie is a  created for creating and running DAOs that get things done in the real world. Unlike traditional DAOs that only handle digital transactions, DAO Genie comes with AI agents that can execute real-world tasks based on your community's decisions.

Key Features:
- Create and manage your DAO in minutes - set up your community, add members, and customize voting powers without any technical headaches
- Vote on proposals through a simple interface that shows you exactly what's happening and who has how much influence
- Let AI agents be your DAO's hands in the real world - they can make purchases, send donations, handle communications, and execute other tasks automatically based on your votes
- Stay secure and informed with AI that understands plain English, verifies all actions, and reports back on completed tasks
how_its_made:
We used next.js, react and zod for this t3 project. We also used Dynamics wallet for login, wagmi for frontend, hardhat for switching between testnets, playwright as the browser to complete tasks.

For the AI Agent part, we upgraded the Aloria project by converting it into a public API for us and other team to use. On top of that, we incorporated new Agentic workflow and added Tesseract OCR to improve the task execution accuracy.
